title: LIKE attracts like AND repels. the ANGLE decides.

do_not_reinvent.poles: /data/force-antipoles.json — magnetic N/S already. do not mint a 16th force.
do_not_reinvent.three: /data/true-parallels.json — orthonormal · oblique · true parallel. those ARE the angles.
do_not_reinvent.color: /data/color-null-radiate.json — colors leave A and reach. attract/repel is how they meet.
do_not_reinvent.static: /data/rustdesk-browser-static.json — the crack holds charge. do not paint a widget in it.

both.attract: like can pull like. same kind seats. mix in the middle.
both.repel: like can also push like. same charge piles unstick. N/N. the 15 unstack.
both.not_xor: not one law forever. both. the angle picks.

angle.90: orthonormal. gyro. attract turns into a perpendicular answer.
angle.45_pi: oblique. slant. weak pull / weak push. the between.
angle.parallel: true parallels. they never meet. that is the strongest 'repel' — no crossing.
angle.at_A: the diamond. green-brown undefined. do not use that pair as the angle.

law: like-like can attract or repel. read the angle first. if we pick only attract we restack. if we pick only repel we never mix.
pull: keep both. let the three angles sort the meet. voltage still leaves A.
